description: Triển khai code cho feature theo TDD — source code + tests + review. v5.2.0: Cross-skill `--from-fix-bugs[=<id>]` flag — Phase 1 step 1.10/1.11 consume `fix-impact.json` từ wf-fix-bugs session (Protocol 21) để prioritize features có code_files trùng `$FEATURE_SLUG`. Auto-resolve latest completed session. Opt-in: không pass flag → behavior cũ (zero regression). v5.1.0: Quality improvement — Environment Profile Detection (phase0-6), Environment Safety Scan (phase0-7 BƯỚC 2b với 5 pattern E1-E5), VERIFY_ONLY lightweight review routing, mandatory security agent cho auth_security/data_layer batches, Agent Output Spot-Check (CORE-029), expanded QA review checklist (Environment Safety + Runtime Safety + i18n & Accessibility). v5.0.0: System-grouped layout — work dir đổi từ flat `$FEATURE_SLUG/sessions/` thành `$SYSTEM_SLUG/$FEATURE_SLUG/sessions/`. Locks và cache cũng scope theo system (.locks/$SYSTEM_SLUG/, .cache/$SYSTEM_SLUG/$MODULE_SLUG/). Auto-derive $SYSTEM_SLUG từ registry features[].system_id → systems[].slug, fallback `_orphan/` khi feature không có trong registry. Cờ mới --system=<slug> để override khi ambiguous. History index .history/implementations-index.jsonl bổ sung field `system` per entry để filter cross-system. Idempotent v4→v5 migration script (`implement-migrate-v4-to-v5.sh`) chạy auto ở Phase 0.0, dùng pre-built map (slug→system) cho O(N) performance. Layout marker `.layout-version=5` phòng tránh re-migrate. Backward compat v3/v4 đầy đủ — chain v3→v4→v5 idempotent. v4 features kế thừa: Session isolation, profile system, pattern cache, consumer_hints schema v2.0, decision registry global, error-ledger namespaced.
